To ensure children and young people are aware of their rights and have access to advocacy when required. To also ensure young people are
aware of their rights and have access to independent advocacy, information, advice and
support in relation to children and young people (up to age 25 where an EHC Plan is in
place) with SEN and Disabilities.

title: Innovation Chain North Framework ("ICN") for construction and associated professional services
description:
Innovation Chain North (ICN) is a framework for construction and associated professional services.
It is designed to support the delivery of new homes and associated social infrastructure across the North of England.
